referenceFidelity.findings: Pale glazing grid, exposed timber skylight beams and stepped oak-topped seating translate the public contemporary GitHub atrium vocabulary into an original detached campus volume. The suspended contribution artwork is intentionally a separate model.

construction.findings: Thin low-alpha glazing is isolated from one opaque packed palette. Added a receiving gallery and actual 25-tread narrow west stair, with an upper doorway and clipped mullion/glass sections. Gallery deck Y5.30 matches the covered bridge when placed atY5; stair and landing rails are fitted and the rear seating stays clear.

readability.findings: Current 390 px viewport clearly separates glazing, roof grid, stairs and stepped seating. Clear glass allows the contribution artwork and furniture to remain visible without dense refraction.

motion.findings: Deliberately static environment architecture, no skeleton or authored clips.

secondPass.findings: Rechecked current exported west elevation, isometric and phone after replacing the empty upper connection with a real stair/gallery and lowering the gallery to match the bridge. The doorway is clear; opposite glazing can be seen through it and is not an opaque local backing.

userAcceptance.note: User authorized creation but has not explicitly accepted this model revision.

limitations: Original interpreted campus architecture; complete measured GitHub as-built CAD documentation was not found.
